reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:291, the patch changed `.topic-meta-data h5 a` from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. Because `dark-light-choose` (app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/variables.scss:48-54) returns its first argument for light themes, the lightness percentages are swapped and light-theme links get 70% lightness instead of 30%, making them much lighter and lower-contrast.
